## Goal
Finish paginated invoice listing response, then fix the high-priority dunning scheduler bug emailing paid customers. Resume ordered webhook v1→v2 cutover afterward.

## Constraints and rules
Never edit `config/ledgerly.toml` without posting its diff in `#billing-config` for `@maya`. Never modify `ledgerly/customer_export/` without a proposed diff and `@mina` approval in `#privacy-review`. Run cutover commands individually and in order. Do not retry the six-hour Celery visibility timeout. Staging exports must use `ledgerly-exports-stg-v2`; the old bucket is frozen.

## Key decisions and facts
Invoice API will return `{items, total, limit, offset}`. Added `InvoicePage`; service now supports `limit=20`, `offset=0`; route validates `limit` 1–100 and nonnegative `offset`. Idempotency race fix is committed as `fix-billing-idempotency-race`.

## Ruled out
Increasing Celery visibility timeout.

## Progress
Idempotency fix passed full suite: 126 passed, 3 skipped; integration: 31 passed; Ruff clean. Invoice route tests: 8 passed, 1 failed only because response wrapping is not yet complete.

## Next steps
Implement service total count and paginated response, rerun invoice/full tests, then investigate scheduler eligibility/delivery and add a regression test.

Split monolithic `ledgerly/api/routes.py` into per-resource routers. Separately, operator requested the ordered “Webhook v1 to v2 cutover” procedure; no cutover steps are recorded as executed.

## Constraints and rules

## Key decisions and facts
Webhook sender now supports bounded retries for transport and retryable server errors, exponential backoff, and `max_attempts` validation. Client errors remain immediate failures. Full suite: 44 passed. Search rebuild baseline: 18 passed, 2 failed due to stale invoice descriptions.

## Ruled out
No retry helper existed initially. Do not retry all `HTTPStatusError`s.

## Progress
Webhook implementation/tests are complete and formatted. `git diff --check` is clean. Search indexing code was inspected; page-by-page invoice queries and serialized embedding are likely bottlenecks. Cutover has not been performed.

## Next steps
Investigate/fix search rebuild failures, then begin route-router refactoring. Before any cutover, execute and verify each listed production command sequentially.

## Goal
Split `ledgerly/api/routes.py` into per-resource routers. Separately prepare the ordered “Webhook v1 to v2 cutover” procedure.

## Constraints and rules
Never edit `config/ledgerly.toml` without posting its diff in `#billing-config` for `@maya`. Never modify `ledgerly/customer_export/` without posting the proposed diff in `#privacy-review` and receiving `@mina`’s approval. Run cutover commands individually in the specified order.

## Key decisions and facts
Search rebuild now uses tenant-scoped queries, concurrent batched embedding, 100-document chunks, and transactional bulk upserts. Migration `0042` adds unique `(tenant_id, document_id)` indexing. Performance improved from median 16.73s to 2.41s.

## Ruled out
No cutover steps have run. CSV export currently relies on platform-default encoding.

## Progress
Search changes are complete: full suite passed with 247 passed, 4 skipped. CSV reproduction: 1 failed, 6 passed.

## Next steps
Fix CSV UTF-8 handling subject to review, investigate remaining search failures if any, then refactor routes into resource routers.
